* Abstract net-peer class.

A net-peer instance is opened and thus bound to the specific port. Then it does all (duplex) communication through that port (the whole family of [localIP:port]-[*:*] requests).

Individual I/O requests are processed by net-channels. Each net-channel object is responsible for respective [localIP:port]-[distantIP:port] communication. @since 27.11.2001 @see NetChannel
